description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_Nmtokens, which validates and processes NMTOKENS attribute types in HTML, primarily used for class attributes. It includes validation logic using regex to parse tokens and reconstruct a sanitized attribute string.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_Nmtokens
classes.description: A class responsible for validating and sanitizing NMTOKENS attribute values in HTML, ensuring proper token structure and content.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes the input string representing NMTOKENS, returning a reconstructed string of valid tokens or false if invalid.
